import pandas as pd

def calculate_1_day_SMA_of_Price_over_60_day_MAX_of_Price():
    df = pd.read_hdf('daily_pv.h5', key='data').sort_index()
    # Calculate 60-day MAX of close price
    max_price_60 = df['close'].groupby(level='instrument', sort=False).rolling(window=60).max().droplevel(0)
    # Calculate 1-day SMA of close price
    sma_1 = df['close'].groupby(level='instrument', sort=False).rolling(window=1).mean().droplevel(0)
    # Compute the factor value
    values = sma_1 / max_price_60 - 1
    result = values.to_frame('1-day SMA of Price over 60-day MAX of Price').reindex(df.index)
    result.to_hdf('result.h5', key='data')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    calculate_1_day_SMA_of_Price_over_60_day_MAX_of_Price()

import pandas as pd

def calculate_1_day_SMA_of_Price_over_60_day_MIN_of_Price():
    df = pd.read_hdf("daily_pv.h5", key="data").sort_index()
    # rolling MUST be per instrument: a plain df[col].rolling(n) on the
    # (datetime, instrument) index mixes different stocks inside one window
    window_price = 60                              # put the factor's window here
    window_min = 60                                 # put the min window here
    price = df["close"].groupby(level="instrument", sort=False).rolling(window=window_min).min().droplevel(0)
    sma_price = df["close"].groupby(level="instrument", sort=False).rolling(window=1).mean().droplevel(0)
    values = sma_price / price - 1
    result = values.to_frame("1-day SMA of Price over 60-day MIN of Price").reindex(df.index)   # keeps datetime+instrument index
    result.to_hdf("result.h5", key="data")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    calculate_1_day_SMA_of_Price_over_60_day_MIN_of_Price()

import pandas as pd

def calculate_composite_factor_of_1_day_sma_of_price_over_60_day_max_of_price_and_1_day_sma_of_price_over_20_day_max_of_price():
    df = pd.read_hdf('daily_pv.h5', key='data').sort_index()
    window_60 = 60
    window_20 = 20
    sma_60 = df['close'].groupby(level='instrument', sort=False).rolling(window_60).mean().droplevel(0)
    sma_20 = df['close'].groupby(level='instrument', sort=False).rolling(window_20).mean().droplevel(0)
    max_60 = df['close'].groupby(level='instrument', sort=False).rolling(window_60).max().droplevel(0)
    max_20 = df['close'].groupby(level='instrument', sort=False).rolling(window_20).max().droplevel(0)
    numerator = sma_60 / max_60 - 1
    denominator = sma_20 / max_20 - 1
    values = numerator / denominator
    result = values.to_frame('Composite Factor of 1-day SMA of Price over 60-day MAX of Price and 1-day SMA of Price over 20-day MAX of Price').reindex(df.index)
    result.to_hdf('result.h5', key='data')

if __name__ == '__main__':

def calculate_1_day_SMA_of_Price_over_30_day_MAX_of_Price():
    df = pd.read_hdf('daily_pv.h5', key='data').sort_index()
    window = 30  # put the factor's window here
    g = df['close'].groupby(level='instrument', sort=False)
    num = g.rolling(window).mean().droplevel(0)
    den = g.rolling(window).max().droplevel(0)
    values = num / den - 1
    result = values.to_frame('1-day SMA of Price over 30-day MAX of Price').reindex(df.index)
    result.to_hdf('result.h5', key='data')

if __name__ == '__main__':
